words.def: done at the right time or without delay.
words.book: Thank you for your attention to this matter, and we appreciate your timely submission.
uses: We appreciate your timely payment of the attached invoice.
Timely maintenance visits prevent most battery failures.
dont: Thank you for sending in the good time.
doo: Thank you for your timely submission.

words.def: a solution to a problem or complaint.
words.book: I'll get back to you with more information or a resolution as soon as possible, no later than ___.
uses: Our service team is working on a resolution and will update you within 24 hours.
any resolution on the Heliopolis site alarm?
We need a quick resolution before the customer escalates.
dont: We will find a solving for the problem.
doo: We'll find a resolution to the issue.

words.def: during the time before something else happens.
words.book: In the meantime, if you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out.
uses: The spare part will arrive next week; in the meantime, we've installed a temporary unit.
in the meantime can you send me the serial numbers?
In the meantime, let's run the site on the generator.
dont: Until this time, use the generator.
doo: In the meantime, please use the generator.

words.def: based on facts and numbers, not on opinions or guesses.
words.book: I achieved this by implementing targeted content strategies, monitoring analytics, and adjusting our approach based on data-driven insights.
uses: Our proposal is data-driven: it is based on 12 months of load readings from your site.
let's keep this data-driven — send me the numbers
We need a data-driven approach to decide which sites get new batteries first.

words.book: Additionally, I collaborated with the content creation team to develop attention-grabbing graphics and videos that further boosted engagement and conversions.
uses: The new solar package boosted our Q3 sales by 20%.
Adding a second battery string will boost the backup time.
dont: This made the sales go up very much.

words.def: special knowledge or skill in a particular field.
words.book: I look forward to the possibility of connecting with you and learning from your expertise.
uses: Our team has extensive expertise in data centre power systems.
we need someone with VFD expertise on this job
Her expertise in solar design helped us win the tender.
dont: He has big experiences in UPS.
doo: He has a lot of expertise in UPS systems.

upgrade.plain: I apply for the job that I saw it on LinkedIn.
upgrade.ar: بقدّم على الوظيفة اللي شفتها على لينكدإن
pro: I apply for the job that I saw it on LinkedIn.
I apply for your job from LinkedIn.
I'm writing to apply for the Sales Engineer position advertised on LinkedIn.
upgrade.why: ماتكررش الضمير: ‎that I saw‎ مش ‎that I saw it‎، وابدأ بـ ‎I'm writing to apply for‎.

upgrade.plain: I think I am good for this job.
pro: I believe I would be a great fit for the role.
I think I am good for this job.
I am suitable person for job.
upgrade.why: ‎a great fit for the role‎ هي الصيغة المستخدمة في طلبات التوظيف.

upgrade.plain: I received your mail and I will see the problem.
pro: I received your mail and I will see the problem.
I wanted to acknowledge receipt of your message; I'm currently looking into the matter.
Your mail reached, I see problem.
upgrade.why: ‎look into‎ = يدرس المشكلة؛ ‎see the problem‎ معناها يبص عليها بس.

upgrade.plain: Don't forget, the last day for the tender is near.
pro: Don't forget, the last day is near!
The tender last day is coming near.
This is just a friendly reminder that the tender deadline is fast approaching.
upgrade.why: ‎deadline‎ بدل ‎last day‎، و ‎friendly reminder‎ أذوق من ‎don't forget‎.

upgrade.plain: Can I take from your time 15 minutes?
upgrade.ar: ممكن آخد من وقتك ربع ساعة؟
pro: Can I take from your time 15 minutes?
Would you be available for a 15–20 minute call next week?
Give me 15 minutes from your time.
upgrade.why: ‎take from your time‎ ترجمة حرفية؛ اسأل ‎Would you be available for …?‎

upgrade.plain: I want to know people in the solar field.
upgrade.ar: عايز أتعرف على ناس في مجال الطاقة الشمسية
pro: I'm always looking to expand my professional network in the solar industry.
I want to know people in the solar field.
I want to make knowing with solar people.
upgrade.why: في النتووركنج قول ‎expand my professional network‎.
